project_type: Static single-page HTML product reference tool for MPS Flexi insurance product (Manulife Indonesia)
build_system: None - single HTML file, no build process needed
test_framework: None - manual verification by opening in browser. Validate HTML structure programmatically.
build_command: python3 -c "import html.parser; p=html.parser.HTMLParser(); f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); content=f.read(); f.close(); print('HTML size:', len(content), 'bytes'); print('Lines:', content.count(chr(10))); assert '<html' in content; assert '</html>' in content; print('PASS: Valid HTML structure')"
test_command: python3 -c "f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); c=f.read(); f.close(); checks=[('WhatsApp link','wa.me/6287781896087'),('Tab system','showTab'),('Calculator','calculate()'),('Password lock','123'),('USD','USD'),('Plan A','Amanah'),('Plan B','Berkah'),('Plan C','Cermat'),('Komisi','Komisi')]; passed=0; total=len(checks); [print(f'  PASS: {n}') if s in c else print(f'  FAIL: {n} missing') for n,s in checks]; passed=sum(1 for n,s in checks if s in c); print(f'{passed}/{total} checks passed'); assert passed==total, 'Some checks failed'"
verification_instructions: 1. Run the build_command to verify HTML structure. 2. Run test_command to verify all required features are present. 3. Check file size is reasonable (under 1MB for self-contained HTML).
setup_instructions: No setup needed. The project is a single HTML file.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external packages can be installed. The HTML must be completely self-contained with inline CSS and JS. No CDN links allowed. The commission image (Komisi MPS Flexi.jpg, 281KB) can be embedded as base64 data URI. No PDF extraction tools available.
contribution_requirements: Single HTML file output. Must be self-contained. Indonesian language. Clickable WhatsApp link on all tabs.
key_patterns: Existing HTML uses: tab-based navigation with showTab() JS function, card-based layouts, green (#00a758) color scheme matching Manulife branding, sticky WhatsApp banner, responsive design with @media queries, inline styles only.
directory_structure: Flat directory with PDFs (source documents, not text-extractable), one JPG (commission structure), and one HTML file (the deliverable to be improved/replaced).
